# Backend tests that can only pass on a provisioned ChemDFT workstation (the Mac).
# CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) deselects exactly these node ids; local runs are
# unchanged and still execute them. Each needs a native engine binary, model
# weights or retained evidence that is not in Git. Recorded 2026-10-25 from a full
# Linux run: every listed failure was one of the reasons below, none was a code
# assertion on available inputs. Remove an id when its test skips cleanly without
# the resource (preferred: mark it @pytest.mark.scientific_integration).
